notes.title: RELEASE DATE: Everspell is coming to Steam on June 26th!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

notes.title: DEMO 1.2 patch
notes.content:
Another small update featuring some new content, QOL improvements and bugfixes.

[list]
[*] Changed casting from keys EZXC to QWER. This makes casting way more comfortable
[*] Updated the Quest UI Menu
[*] ​Updated tutorial for some more clarity on what you need to do.
[*] Your health is now visible in numbers when in combat
[*] Added auto-saving
[*] Lava does not kill you instantly anymor
[*] You can now buy a healing spell scroll
[*] Pressing ESC now exits out of most UI things (inventory, dialogues etc.) without opening the settings
[*] Added some chill background music
[*] Some other minor bugfixes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481865/62be93d06ec52939aeb6e338ade6e524c9b07e1f.gif[/img]

notes.title: DEMO 1.1 hotfix
notes.content:
Just a small update with some QOL improvements and bugfixes:

[list]
[*] Enemies health is now visible in numbers
[*] Updated tutorial for some more clarity on what you need to do.
[*] Nerfed Specters, less health and they can only disappear one time in a row
[*] Hard spells are now slightly easier to cast
[*] Health is now also displayed in your inventory (helps to heal)
[*] Rage curse buffed slightly 
[*] Some other minor bugfixes
[/list]
